conversation_closed_check.name: conversation_closed_check
conversation_closed_check.value:
("conversation"."closed_at" IS NULL) = ("conversation"."closed_how" IS NULL)
        AND ("conversation"."closed_at" IS NULL) = ("conversation"."closed_by" IS NULL)

gate_opened_check.name: gate_opened_check
gate_opened_check.value: "gate"."opened_at" IS NULL OR "gate"."admitted_at" IS NOT NULL

report_note_check.name: report_note_check
report_note_check.value: "report"."note" IS NULL OR char_length("report"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 500

report_decision_check.name: report_decision_check
report_decision_check.value:
("report"."outcome" IS NULL) = ("report"."decided_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("report"."decided_by" IS NULL) = ("report"."decided_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("report"."sanction_id" IS NULL OR "report"."outcome" = 'acted')

sanction_lift_check.name: sanction_lift_check
sanction_lift_check.value: "sanction"."lifted_by" IS NULL OR "sanction"."lifted_at" IS NOT NULL

sanction_review_check.name: sanction_review_check
sanction_review_check.value:
("sanction"."reviewed_at" IS NULL AND "sanction"."reviewed_by" IS NULL AND "sanction"."review_note" IS NULL)
        OR ("sanction"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "sanction"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL
          AND "sanction"."review_note" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("sanction"."review_note") BETWEEN 1 AND 500)

sanction_rule_check.name: sanction_rule_check
sanction_rule_check.value:
("sanction"."rule" IS NULL) = ("sanction"."rule_count" IS NULL)
        AND ("sanction"."rule" IS NULL) = ("sanction"."rule_first_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("sanction"."rule" IS NULL OR ("sanction"."created_by" IS NULL AND "sanction"."kind" = 'shadow_ban'
          AND "sanction"."rule_count" >= 1 AND "sanction"."rule_first_at" <= "sanction"."created_at"))
